messages:
Maya (growth): Need a crisp one-pager for enterprise buyers that ties deploy modes to SLA promises + inbound routing for the field. Tone: confident, factual, and short.
Diego (product): Agreed. Core audience: infra/platform leads, SREs, security/compliance. Keep sections: Why it matters, Deploy mode comparison, Verified performance snapshot, How to engage (routing + PoC).
Ruth (eng-ml): Benchmarks we can publicly show (conservative): Hosted p95 (2k prompt) ~ 260ms, Dedicated (reserved multi-GPU pool) p50 ~ 60ms / p95 ~ 190ms, Private (customer HW, A100 sample) p95 ~ 150ms. Throughput: Dedicated pool handles ~750 reqs/min at 512-token avg with autoscale. Cost ballpark for 1M tokens: $70

- $110 depending on quant and batching. Put an explicit disclaimer: "Measured on representative workloads; contact us for tailored benchmarks."
Omar (field): Routing matrix suggestion: inbound form tags -> sec-eval, sla-question, private-interest. Automations: sec-eval -> AE security-specialist; private-interest -> solutions-eng + open ticket to infra-ops. Also surface high-priority leads (gov/healthcare/finance) to AE-direct.
Chen (design): I can do a single-page layout: small hero table (Hosted | Dedicated | Private) + 3 pillar icons (SLA uptime, Data Controls, Cost predictability). Include a narrow benchmark strip with the numbers Ruth gave. Want to use a subtle grid of lock icons for security section.
Maya (growth): Webinar hook idea: "SLA Contracts & Secure Inference: A Migration Playbook". Speakers: Diego + Ruth + customer panel. Timing: 2.5 weeks. CTAs on one-pager: Download PDF, Request PoC, Register for webinar.
Diego (product): Add a 5-step migration checklist: 1) Compliance scoping 2) Choose deploy mode 3) Baseline perf & cost 4) Request tailored benchmark 5) Canary rollout + monitor. Keep it actionable and short.
Ruth (eng-ml): Sample external benchmark snippet to include (single line): "Typical verified p95 for 2k gen: Hosted ~260ms, Dedicated ~190ms (reserved), Private: varies; ask for your workload test."
Omar (field): SDR/AE play: SDR sequence: email 1 - brief value prop + link to one-pager, email 2 - benchmark tease + webinar invite, call 1 - offer tailored benchmark/PoC. Tag leads in CRM as secure_eval and set priority if company in regulated sector.
Maya (growth): Social/launch copy (short): "Redwood Inference: Predictable SLAs & security controls across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Download the brief and book an on-demand benchmark."
LegalBot: Reminder: Any SLA claims must be approved by Legal before publishing. Submit the one-pager to #legal-review within 24h.
Chen (design): Assets list: hero micro-table, three security icons (KMS, audit-logs, VPC), benchmark strip PNG, and a 1-slide webinar graphic. Ill deliver PNG + PDF by EOD tomorrow.
Diego (product): Also add an appendix note for customers: "If you require on-prem/air-gapped, we provide an assisted deployment path and integration checklist." Keep the one-pager itself focused.
Maya (growth): Distribution plan: Landing page w/ PDF -> blog post summary -> social bursts -> webinar -> SDR nurture. Omar, you coordinate CRM tags and Slack alerts to #sales-ops.
Omar (field): Will map the routing flows for Finance, Healthcare, Gov and share a 1-sheet. Also recommend a short discovery template for AE: compliance req, data residency, throughput needs, SLA target.
Diego (product): Action items: Ruth - finalize external benchmark line; Chen - mock + assets by EOD tomorrow; Omar - routing matrix; Maya - draft external copy v1. I'll assemble the migration checklist and webinar plan.
Maya (growth): Great. Keep the one-pager word count <350. We'll iterate copy here once Chen drops the mock. :sparkles:
